text:
Maya Iqbal: FYI I ran a quick tokens/sec sweep across APAC pools this morning — seeing a persistent ~8% throughput gap vs EU on identical model mix. Root cause looks like prefetch+kv-cache warming on instance churn, plus occasional cross-region TCP tail latency.

Sam Park: logs?

Maya Iqbal: pasted sample metrics: prefetch_miss_rate=0.12, avg_kv_warmups_per_request=0.03, tokens/sec_p95=4200 (APAC) tokens/sec_p95=4550 (EU).

Oliver Reyes: can you dump the pod eviction / spot preemption timeline?

Maya Iqbal: snippet:
```
2025-07-12T02:13Z node-az3: spot-terminate
2025-07-12T02:13:05Z evict: pool-prefetch-3
2025-07-12T02:13:07Z prefetch-rewarm start
```
Not massive but frequent enough during shoulder hours.

Jin Ho: is this more about cold-starting KV cache or network RTT variance? APAC peering had a config change last month.

NetOps: lowered BGP multipath for apac-egress last week — could increase tail by 10-20ms in some regions.

Sam Park: quick calc — if prefetch miss adds 25ms per request on average and we have 200 qps, that's 5 GPU-sec/sec => 18k GPU-sec/hour wasted. That matches observed extra GPU-hours.

Maya Iqbal: exact. Our accounting shows ~0.9 GPU-hour burn per hour across the APAC pool during shoulder windows.

Oliver Reyes: options: 1) increase prefetch cache size (memory), 2) reduce spot churn by moving critical pools to reserved, 3) smart backoff for prefetch during eviction storms.

Jin Ho: also consider routing policy: send low-latency SLAs to eu-central by default during apac peering variance — but that raises egress cost.

Maya Iqbal: trade-offs: if we reserve more capacity to avoid spot churn, committed monthly cost up ~12% but reduces waste and improves tail. If we route to EU for ~2% of traffic, egress adds $0.03/token on those requests.

Sam Park: propose small experiment: for next 48h, mark 10% of APAC traffic as 'prefetch-light' (no aggressive rewarm) and reroute 5% to EU for heavy token-length > 1k. Measure tokens/sec, GPU-hour delta.

Maya Iqbal: +1. I'll drop a canary config: prefork_rate=0.3 -> 0.1, route_overflow_to=eu-central:priority=low. CapacityBot: schedule?

CapacityBot: scheduled canary on 2056789020 for 48h across pools apac-1{a,b}. Notifying billing.

NetOps: FYI I'll revert the BGP tweak in 6h to see impact; will post metrics.

Oliver Reyes: add metric to console: 'prefetch_waste_gpu_sec' and tokenized p95 by region.

Jin Ho: documenting runbook: if prefeth_waste_gpu_sec > 1.0 GPU-hour/hour -> promote pool to reserved-tier and enable gradual draining.

Maya Iqbal: thanks. I'll collect logs and upload a short notebook with calculations to the shared drive and ping here when results in.
thread_summary: APAC throughput gap due to prefetch/KV cache rewarm and BGP change; plan canary to reduce prefetch, route overflow to EU, monitor GPU-hour waste and metrics.
